name: cavemio-drop-zone
title: Drop zone
description: A considered file uploader. Clear actions, quiet progress and useful feedback.

cavemio.accessibility:
- A native button provides keyboard browsing. Paste files while focus is inside the component. File results are announced through live regions, and each progress bar is labelled with its file name.
- Drag listeners belong to the drop area, so multiple uploaders can sit on a page independently. No window listeners, proximity targets or perpetual animation loop.
- Remove, replacement and unmount abort the relevant uploads. Late progress or promise results from a cancelled attempt are ignored. Retry starts a fresh attempt.
- Duplicates are compared by file name, size, MIME type and last-modified time. Remove a file to select it again.
- All supporting files ship together, along with Text morph and Number roll for the original quiet label and progress feedback. No animation library or additional stylesheet keyframes.
- Reduced motion keeps labels, numbers and status icons in place. Feedback remains visible as text, a check and progress.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onUpload
props.description: – · Uploads a file with { progress, signal }. Resolve to mark Uploaded; throw to show Retry. Without this callback, files stay Ready.

props.name: onFilesChange
props.description: – · Current selection after adding, replacing or removing files. Progress updates do not trigger this callback.

props.name: onFilesRejected
props.description: – · Rejected files with a reason and a type, size, count or duplicate code, for your own feedback or logging.

props.name: accept
props.description: – · Native file-input syntax: MIME types, wildcards or extensions, e.g. "image/*,.pdf".

props.name: maxSize
props.description: – · Maximum size per file in bytes. The limit appears in the default hint.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: – · Maximum number of files in the selection. Excess files are skipped; valid files still get added.

props.name: multiple
props.description: true · false accepts one file and replaces the previous valid selection. An invalid replacement keeps the current file.

props.name: title
props.description: "Drop files here" · Heading inside the drop area.

props.name: hint
props.description: – · Custom file requirements below the heading. Defaults to the accepted types and configured limits.

props.name: disabled
props.description: false · Disables browsing, adding, removing and retrying. In-flight uploads continue.

props.name: ref
props.description: – · browse(), drop(files, at?), drag(x, y, types?) and cancel() for app-driven file selection. Coordinates are accepted only inside the drop area.

props.name: className
props.description: – · Styles the root. Standard div attributes and style are also forwarded.

features.title: Drop, browse or paste
features.description: The whole area opens the file picker, files can be dragged onto it, and pasted files are added.

features.title: It validates the files
features.description: Type, size, count and duplicates are checked. Rejections are listed under the area, and onFilesRejected tells your code why.

features.title: Progress in each row
features.description: Name, size, a rolling percent and a ring, with the row’s bottom thin line filling as it uploads.

features.title: Cancel and Retry
features.description: Cancel aborts the upload, late results from a cancelled attempt are ignored, and a failed file offers Retry.

features.title: Selection-only mode
features.description: Without onUpload the files are marked Ready and handed to your form through onFilesChange.

features.title: Several on one page
features.description: Drag listeners belong to the drop area and there are no window listeners, so uploaders do not interfere with each other.

states.title: idle
states.description: The original 18px upload surface, circular arrow and inline Browse or paste prompt. The whole surface is a button. Its height starts at 152px and grows for wider containers or longer hints.

states.title: drag over
states.description: Only the drop area responds: the border and background take a restrained accent, and the label morphs to "Release to add". Its shape stays fixed.

states.title: ready
states.description: Without onUpload, files are marked Ready and passed to onFilesChange for use in a form. They are never reported as uploaded.

states.title: uploading
states.description: A compact thin line row shows the file name, size, rolling percentage and a progress ring. Its bottom thin line fills with progress. Cancel removes the file and aborts its upload.

states.title: complete
states.description: The progress ring gives way to the original small blue drawn check when your upload callback resolves. Completion is also announced as Uploaded.

states.title: error
states.description: Failed and Retry stay on the compact row, while the message uses a separate full-width line underneath. Invalid types, oversized files, duplicates and excess files are listed below the drop area until dismissed or another selection is made.
